reason: The plugin observes DeepSeek Harness sessions and exports structured OpenTelemetry traces to an OTLP/HTTP collector, making monitoring and telemetry its primary user-facing purpose; uploading can include session content and is disabled by default.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话转换为 OpenTelemetry traces，并通过 OTLP/HTTP 导出到指定观测性收集器。
summaries.en: Converts DeepSeek Harness sessions into OpenTelemetry traces and exports them to a configured observability collector over OTLP/HTTP.

capabilities: Exports DeepSeek Harness session traces via OTLP/HTTP
Transmits user and assistant messages, tool arguments and results, model metadata, usage data, and session paths when uploading is enabled
Supports configurable batching and shutdown behavior
Provides live and feedback-triggered telemetry modes
